claims.gist: Platform layer is consolidating while capability layer unbundles at the same time
Large security vendors have acquired cloud security startups
Consolidation reduces integration work and links misconfigurations to identity risk and alerts
Narrow deep capabilities like Kubernetes runtime and identity analysis justify unbundling
Platforms will win the baseline; specialists must be clearly better at hard problems
Standalone tools that only duplicate platform features will struggle
Buyers should demand open export and APIs and test claims in a proof of concept

thesis: CNAPP consolidates at the platform layer while unbundling at the capability layer; buyers should separate the two.
